interpretation.acute_outlier_probe: baseline displacement after one 3x observation; measures premature adaptation (lower is better)
interpretation.adaptation_lag_days: days from drift onset to the LAST alert; equals remaining horizon if it never adapts (lower is better)
interpretation.baseline_shift_std_total: total baseline centre movement over the evaluation period, in pre-drift std units (context, not a score)
interpretation.persistent_false_alarm_rate: fraction of post-drift steady-state days still alerted (lower is better)
